# Frequently asked questions {#sec-faq}

## Core game

**Can a piece in superposition be split again?**
: No. A piece must be measured before it can be split again.

**Can I measure my own pieces?**
: Yes. Sometimes that's the best move!

## Levels 2–5

**Can I play a Quantum card on another player's turn?**
: No, unless the card says so.
